study.research_question: Is the Jev helper's joint intent and target accuracy within 5 points of the Astra typed helper on a designer-authored panel?
study.research_gap: Earlier cohorts used label-only verdicts, three authored tasks and serial arms; calibration, reliability and load-matched comparison were not measured.
study.hypothesis: Paired joint accuracy delta CI lower bound above -0.05.

primary_metric.name: intent_joint_accuracy_delta
primary_metric.aggregation: (Jev joint intent+target correct - Astra) / N_items; invalid helper output = wrong

study.decision_rule: supported: CI lower bound above -0.05; not-supported: CI upper bound below -0.05; mixed otherwise. Designer-authored, not held-out (run-packets/i-panel/README.md).
study.invalidation_rule: Judgment-output invalid (schema, label, non-finite probability, Jev Choice sum beyond strict 1e-5, verdict not an argmax label, refusal, unexpected stop reason) is a valid attempt with a wrong answer: it stays in accuracy denominators and is excluded from probability metrics. Infrastructure invalid (no response, timeout, missing capture or receipt, harness error, quota exhaustion) is validity=invalid, outcome=unknown. Preregistered panel exception: a transport failure without any response is kept as an unselected invalid attempt and replaced exactly once by a child attempt on the same input; a failed replacement stays selected, makes the primary not measurable and stops the unit; replacements above 2% of planned calls stop the unit. Quota exhaustion, harness errors and route violations (non-subscription Astra, model, effort or provider drift, global Jev) are selected invalid attempts and stop the unit. Pin #2 (0028): non-quota HTTP 429 is rate_limited; wait Retry-After (seconds or HTTP-date, default 30 s, clipped to 0-120 s) then exactly one replacement under the same 2% ceiling. retry_wait_s is excluded from measured latency. quota, billing, usage_limit, usage_not_included and plan_limit codes, HTTP 402 and BillingError are quota_exhausted: stop without replacement.
